columns.name: Name
columns.description: The tag's name; one row per tag.

columns.name: Category
columns.description: The tag's group.

columns.name: Counterpart
columns.description: The opposite tag it pairs with (Self-contained for Context-dependent).

columns.name: Description
columns.description: One or two sentences describing a claim that carries the tag.

columns.name: Evidence
columns.description: The report the tag's verification rests on.

columns.name: Example Claims
columns.description: Claims that show the tag, one per line.

columns.name: Geo Status
columns.description: Whether the tag exists in Geo.

columns.name: Geo Tag ID
columns.description: The tag's id in Geo.

columns.name: Polarity
columns.description: Kept as in the taxonomy; the agent does not use it.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: Whether the tag is verified.

columns.name: Verified on
columns.description: When the tag was verified.

columns.name: When to use
columns.description: The numbered rules the agent applies; a tag is judged only when this holds rules.

columns.name: Work tags
columns.description: The work the tag belongs to; every row here has Issue.

columns.name: Created
columns.description: When the row was made.

columns.name: Created by
columns.description: Who made the row.

columns.name: Last edited
columns.description: When the row last changed.

columns.name: Last edited by
columns.description: Who last changed the row.

columns.name: Geo Name
columns.description: The claim text.

columns.name: Geo ID
columns.description: The claim's identity in Geo; the queue's Key starts with it.

columns.name: Geo URL
columns.description: The claim's page in Geo.

columns.name: Geo Sources
columns.description: The claim's sources, as Geo lists them.

columns.name: Geo Tags
columns.description: The claim's tags in Geo.

columns.name: Geo Topics
columns.description: The claim's topics in Geo.

columns.name: Geo Score
columns.description: The claim's score in Geo.

columns.name: Geo Supporting arguments
columns.description: Arguments for the claim, as in Geo.

columns.name: Geo Opposing arguments
columns.description: Arguments against the claim, as in Geo.

columns.name: Geo Related people
columns.description: People linked to the claim in Geo.

columns.name: Geo Related projects
columns.description: Projects linked to the claim in Geo.

columns.name: Geo Is factual
columns.description: Ticked when Geo marks the claim as factual.

columns.name: Geo Name source
columns.description: Which space the claim's name was taken from.

columns.name: Agent tags
columns.description: The tags that apply and are not waiting for an editor, comma-separated, or empty.

columns.name: Agent notes
columns.description: At most two short lines: line 1 the tags that apply or "no tags"; line 2 how many tags wait for an editor, what was not checked, and the rulebook edition, joined with " · ".

columns.name: Claim
columns.description: The claim text.

columns.name: Key
columns.description: The claim's Geo ID, two colons, the tag; one row per claim and tag.

columns.name: Tag
columns.description: The tag the row is about.

columns.name: Agent proposal
columns.description: The agent's answer.

columns.name: Agent confidence
columns.description: How sure the agent is of its answer, from 0.5 (a coin flip) to 1 (certain); the queue is sorted by it, lowest first.

columns.name: Agent reason
columns.description: At most 40 words, then the rule cited and how many runs agreed.

columns.name: Claim link
columns.description: Link to the claim's row in the Claims copy.

columns.name: Rulebook edition
columns.description: The edition the proposal was made under.

columns.name: Follow-up
columns.description: Set after a safety check PASS, on the rows the change rests on.

columns.name: Tag outcome
columns.description: The editor's decision; empty means the row waits.

columns.name: Why wrong
columns.description: The editor's reason the agent was wrong.

columns.name: Your reasoning
columns.description: The editor's words; "rule 4" typed here names the rule.

columns.name: Lesson
columns.description: A short name for the change.

columns.name: Tag
columns.description: The tag the change is about.

columns.name: Rule
columns.description: Which rule, for example "Context-dependent rule 3".

columns.name: Kind
columns.description: What kind of change.

columns.name: Current text
columns.description: The rule's text now.

columns.name: Proposed text
columns.description: The text the agent proposes.

columns.name: Safety check result
columns.description: For example "PASS: examples 11/11, earlier 10/10, yours 2/2" or "FAIL: 'Excluding CNN from Air Force One violates the federal court order' now Does not apply".

columns.name: Supporting rows
columns.description: One line per decided row the change rests on: the claim shortened, " · ", the row's Key.

columns.name: Editor wording
columns.description: The rule as the editor words it; when filled, the safety check tests it instead of the Proposed text. Never written by the agent.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: The editor sets Approved and Rejected; the agent sets Proposed, Live and Rolled back.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: The row's name, Claim tagger.

columns.name: Paused
columns.description: Ticked by a person, every command then refuses; cleared by a person.

columns.name: Rulebook edition
columns.description: The edition in force: a date plus a count, such as 2026-10-16.1; it goes up when a rule changes.

columns.name: Last run summary
columns.description: One short line, such as "Promote · 16 Oct 11:20 · PASS".

views.name: Needs your note
views.filter: Why wrong is Rule unclear or Rule should change, and Your reasoning is empty
